title: [Expense tests] Re-enable reviewed APIs and consolidate Expense fixes
summary: Expense API tests are re-enabled by consolidating authentication mechanisms and removing API-specific test exclusions, while fixing policy snapshot test issues and preserving non-API exclusions.
key_points: Migrated 11 Expense API and helper paths to shared authentication
Removed 51 Expense API test exclusions while preserving 9 non-API exclusions
Enabled existing clean test codeunit execution using existing DisabledTests selectors
Consolidated fixes for policy URL composition, response isolation, and permission handling
No new runner implementations or test scope changes introduced
quote: Migrate the 11 reviewed Expense API/helper paths to shared authentication and remove exactly 51 existing Expense API exclusions.
